"''Not exactly. We are using an alternate mode of transport. My calculations have us crashing towards the upper forest region of the planet.|Hunter and Tech|}} The '''upper forest region''' was a region located on a [[mountain]] range on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Serenno]], in close proximity to [[Castle Serenno]] and [[Serenno City]]. The region was home to a large, multi-[[color]]ed [[forest]] of light green and purple [[Tree|leaves]]. By [[19 BBY]], [[Romar Adell's domicile]] was located there. In 19 BBY, members of [[Clone Force 99]] crashed in a [[cargo container]] on the cliffside of the region. [[Tech]], [[Echo]] and [[Omega]] all survived however in the crash landing, Tech broke his left femur. The group later traversed the region where they met with [[Serennian]] survivor [[Romar Adell]]. With no choice, Adell later led them to his domicile where they took shelter. After resting, Omega went on a rogue mission to retrieve some of [[Dooku's war chest]] in the cargo container that they crashed in earlier. This caused Adell and the rest of the group to find Omega before [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces captured her. They were successful and managed to save Omega from Imperial forces. They later left the region and the planet in the ''[[Marauder (Omicron-class)|Marauder]]''. ==History== [[File:Upper_forest_region_inside_forest.png|thumb|right|381x381px|Tech, Echo and Omega traversing the region.]] During an attempted [[Mission to Castle Serenno|raid]] on [[Castle Serenno]] by [[Clone Force 99]] in the early [[Imperial Era]], members of the Bad Batch detached several [[cargo container]]s containing [[Dooku's war chest]] that were being transported offworld from [[Transport Three]].{{TBB|Spoils of War}} At least one such container, which [[Tech]], [[Echo]], and [[Omega]] were in, crash-landed in the region, close to the edge of a cliff with Tech having a broken femur from the crash landing. After escaping the container, the Bad Batch members trekked across the region until they encountered [[Serennian]] survivor [[Romar Adell]] spying on them. This led to Adell, with no choice, to take them to his domicile. When the Bad Batch members entered Adell's domicile and rested, the members had a heated conversation with Romar regarding the war chest. Later, Adell gave Omega a [[kaleidoscope]] and asked Tech to help in repairing a Model two [[datacore]]. Tech managed to repair the data core and restored its memory which included Serennian history, culture, [[Artist|art]], [[music]], and memories. While Adell thanked Tech for restoring the datacore's memory, Echo came back from scouting for any troopers and asked where Omega was. With Tech speculating that Omega went after the cargo container that crashed on a cliffside of the region, both members immediately went to where the container crashed. Feeling indebted to Tech, Adell followed along. While Tech and Echo were traveling, Omega used the rappelling cable she stole from Adell to enter the cargo container. Immediately when Echo arrived, the Empire found the Bad Batch members and opened fire on them. This caused Echo to lock himself and Omega in the cargo container to evade blasterfire. When Tech arrived, he noticed the Empire preparing for a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[gunship]] with more reinforcements to arrive. This meant that Tech had to take out the troopers. He managed to [[stun]] the troopers present before passing out because of his injury on his left femur. After Adell woke Tech up, an LAAT/i gunship was arriving to the location the previous [[clone trooper]]s reported. With no time to waste, Tech manned the guns and destroyed the LAAT/i gunship and two incoming [[BARC speeder]]s while Adell got the rappelling cable to get Echo and Omega to safety. Adell managed to get Echo and Omega to safety before the container fell from the cliffside. Immediately after, the ''[[Marauder (Omicron-class)|Marauder]]'' arrived to pick up the remaining members. Before leaving, Adell gave Omega the kaleidoscope to keep and said goodbye. The ''Marauder'' then left Serenno and jumped to [[hyperspace]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:UpperForestRegion-LightingConcept.png|thumb|right|381x381px|The lighting concept of the Upper forest region was done by Molly Denmark.]] The location first appeared in the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|Bad Batch Season 2]]-episode premiere [[Spoils of War]] and [[Ruins of War]] released on [[January 4]], [[2023]] on [[Disney+]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}} The lighting concept of a cargo container, housing Tech, Echo and Omega, about to crash into the Upper forest region was done by [[Molly Denmark]]. The lighting concept of Omega looking down at the crashed cargo container was also done by the same artist.{{SW|url=ruins-of-war-concept-art-gallery|text="Ruins of War" Concept Art Gallery | The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 6}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Upper forest region}} *{{TBB|Spoils of War}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|Ruins of War}} {{1stID|upper forest region}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/ruins-of-war-episode-guide|text="Ruins of War" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Región boscosa superior |ja=上層森林地帯 |ka=ზედა ტყის რეგიონი }} [[Category:Forests and woods]] [[Category:Serenno locations]]
